title: Mesh
description: See every station around you and across the mesh, how each is reached, and what it shares.
summary: Every XPRS station this device hears, as a list that scales to hundreds: local ones over Bluetooth, WiFi and LAN, regional ones over LoRa and radio, global ones over Reticulum. Open a station to see how a message gets to it, hop by hop and bearer by bearer, with anything not confirmed marked as a guess. Browse what the station shares through its own page: galleries, music and files, including private rooms you are a member of. The Mesh tab keeps the live picture of nodes, hubs and links, and the hub settings.
